newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil surges with futures, but physical thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil surges with futures, but physical thin.

text.p: NWE gas oil was propelled sharply higher by a leap in underlying futures on Monday, but premiums held more or less steady in a quiet physical market.
Benchmark IPE June gas oil closed $4.75 a tonne higher at $177.75, catching up with crude's late gains on Friday.
A holiday through most of Europe stifled activity on the physical market.
Limited discussion was heard on low sulphur diesel, which was talked around June IPE +$11/$12 cif Le Havre.
An EN590 June swap traded unchanged from late last week at June +$10 a tonne.
But the heating oil market was virtually dead, traders said, with differentials notionally unchanged at +3.50/$4.25 for DIN basis Hamburg and +$3.00/$4.50 a tonne for FOD basis Le Havre.
On the barge market, traders that were at their desks were deterred from making deals by surging screen levels.
